response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(h.award_count) AS total_award_count, AVG(h.share) AS average_share, AVG(h.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM hand_shares AS h CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE h.share > a.share
